description: Identity tints for GoLens file-type icons. A tint says which family a file belongs to; it never signals state. Hues avoid GoLens's reserved meanings: accent blue (selection, interaction, ~211 deg), red (error, removal), orange/yellow (warning), green (success, new). Exception (owner decision 2026-11-05): folders use the theme accent, like the Xcode and Finder navigators.

contrastTargets.normal: >= 3:1 against every sidebar background below (WCAG 1.4.11 non-text contrast)

sidebarBackgrounds.note: Approximations of the vibrant sidebar, its darker wallpaper-tinted state and the unemphasized selected row. On an emphasized (accent) selected row every icon is drawn white instead of tinted.

renderingModes.tinted: Default. Monochrome rendering filled with the icon's identity tint. Highest legibility at 16 px.
renderingModes.hierarchical: Optional, for 20 pt and larger (Quick Open, welcome screen). Symbol layers: primary = tint at 100%, secondary = tint at the system hierarchical opacity (about 50%). Secondary layers fall below 3:1, so do not use it in the 16 px sidebar.
renderingModes.monochrome: User setting 'Colored file icons' off: every icon uses NSColor.secondaryLabelColor, the current GoLens rule (DESIGN_SYSTEM.md 2.5).

selectedRow: Emphasized selection: NSColor.alternateSelectedControlTextColor (white). Unemphasized selection: keep the tint.

go.meaning: Go language: .go, _test.go, generated Go, go.mod, go.sum, go.work, Go templates

infra.meaning: Containers and deployment: Dockerfile, Compose, .dockerignore, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform

data.meaning: Data and config formats: YAML, JSON, TOML, INI/XML config, Protobuf, GraphQL, SQL

web.meaning: Web and media: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, images

neutral.meaning: Everything else: docs (Markdown, LICENSE, text), tooling (Makefile, shell, .env, git, CI), generic files. Neutral on purpose: these are frequent and should not compete with names, git status or diagnostics.
neutral.note: Hex values are preview approximations only; in the app use the semantic system color.

accent.meaning: Every folder, plain or badged: filled folder glyph in the active theme's accent (ThemeManager.accentNSColor; the Xcode (System) theme uses NSColor.controlAccentColor, so the user's macOS accent applies).
accent.system: Theme accent, adjusted at runtime by FileIconPalette.accent
accent.note: Hex values are the default blue accent after adjustment, for previews only. At runtime the accent is blended toward black (light) or white (dark) in 5% steps until it reaches the contrast target against every sidebarBackgrounds entry and, for the custom dark themes, the theme's panel background. Accents that already pass are used unchanged.

gopher.meaning: Flat multicolor artwork for go, go-test and go-generated (tools/gopher.py bakes these into template/<name>-color-<variant>.pdf). Not tinted at runtime; Colored icons off and the emphasized selection use the one-color cut-out silhouette template/<name>.pdf instead.
gopher.bodyNote: Light uses the Go brand cyan, below 3:1 against the light sidebar (2.3:1 on #E8E8ED). Owner decision: accepted because the file name always sits next to the icon and the white eyes and dark pupils carry the shape. Increase Contrast uses the go tint (5.27:1 light) and its lighter dark variant.
gopher.badgeNote: Test check and generated gear use the go tint, so a thin badge stroke keeps >= 3:1.
